title: September 15 short-interest report showed a 31.45% decline
mechanism: Reported short positioning materially eased, weakening one of the structural mechanisms required for a nonlinear squeeze.
stateEffect: Weakens the short-pressure engine without changing the ATTENTION state; delayed short interest does not establish current positioning or direct covering.
observations: 39,069,126 shares were reported short for the September 15 settlement date.
The prior August 31 report was 56,990,026 shares, a decline of 17,920,900 shares or 31.45%.
Using 504,500,990 shares outstanding from the September 3 filing baseline, reported short interest is about 7.74% of shares outstanding, below the Watch's 20% structural gate.
